summary: Lucas GC Ltd filed a Form 6-K updating its financing plans. The company announced the termination of its at-the-market offering program and the discontinuation of a proposed public offering of Class A ordinary shares, ordinary warrants, and pre-funded warrants. No securities were ever issued or sold under either program. The decision was attributed to current market conditions, capital structure, and financing costs. The company retains flexibility under its existing financing arrangement and will continue evaluating alternatives. This is an ordinary business update regarding withdrawn capital-raising plans, not a special situation. There is no transaction, no party, no terms, and no risk-arb angle.
